ceiling: Configuration validation only, so it confirms an SBOM format, components and the omit-versions flag are declared; it does not generate or validate an SBOM.
offer: Record a machine-readable software inventory with exact component versions. An SBOM describes shipped components; it does not by itself establish license or vulnerability compliance.

minimal.reason: Declare the SBOM format, such as CycloneDX or SPDX. A tool cannot read an unspecified format, so name it.

mid.reason: List the components in the inventory. An empty SBOM describes nothing shipped, so include every component.

maximal.reason: Set omitting dependency versions to false. A component without an exact version cannot be matched to advisories, so record versions.

rule.reason: Declare the SBOM format, such as CycloneDX or SPDX. A tool cannot read an unspecified format, so name it.
